other_failure_modes.name: DataFrame fragmentation in loop
other_failure_modes.description: Adding many new columns to a pandas DataFrame one by one inside a loop causes severe memory fragmentation and exponential performance degradation, often leading to execution timeouts on wide datasets. It is better to collect new columns in a dictionary or list and concatenate them at once.

summary: The solution follows robust data science practices concerning data leakage, successfully fitting all transformers and imputers correctly on the training set after the split. However, it fails to account for the stochastic variance of the model by evaluating it exactly once, and relies solely on one evaluation metric. Additionally, adding transformed features iteratively in a loop modifies the DataFrame in-place, which causes severe memory fragmentation and likely led to the 7200-second execution timeout observed in the logs.
